summary.text: Jessica Feldmark is a Democratic delegate representing District 12A in the Maryland House of Delegates, where she has served since 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She faces Republican Frank Glover and fellow Democratic incumbent Terri L. Hill for the district's two seats.

paragraphs.text: Jessica Feldmark earned a B.A. in sociology and international relations from Goucher College and an M.S. in organization development from American University.
Her career experience includes work as a training and special projects manager with Volunteer Maryland.
She has served on the boards of directors of Wilde Lake Village and NARAL Pro-Choice Maryland.
Feldmark serves on the Ways and Means Committee in the 2025-2026 session.
